summary: The new Multiquadratic/Frobenius.lean re-derives four helpers that MultiquadraticSplitting.lean already has (integrality of √d, its packaging in 𝓞 K, the squaring identity, the liesOver-membership criterion) and copies its adjoin-induction block verbatim; NumberField/Frobenius.lean adds unused thin wrappers over Mathlib's existence API. The genuinely new content (the Legendre-sign computation) is fine.
